title: AI can create the tools you are paying for
author: EverythingBOffensive
selftext:
Just FYI, you should not be paying credits to scammers for slop. "AI Slop" is poorly trained AI or bad prompts. You need to have AI make your own software. Its the best way to stand out. 

If you buy assets from AI vendors, you won't stand out, your work will be hard to distinguish from theirs.

I do this for free, and provide it for free. You can do it to, in your own way. 

To reverse the bad reputation, we need to give back.

This is not my best example but I thoroughly enjoyed it and it only took 3 prompts to make in gpt. This allows people to make a map in the game and play it as its being made. 

Alternatively you can drop a file in that similar format and instantly play a simulated 3d world of your drawing.

I left off at the mobs, I haven't gotten back to it yet but it will be on [https://glitchedmatr1x.github.io/GLITCHED-MATRIX-Prototype-Lab/](https://glitchedmatr1x.github.io/GLITCHED-MATRIX-Prototype-Lab/) for free just like the other prototypes once its ready.

comments.author: scratchieee
comments.body: What tool is this supposed to be replacing, Blender, Unity, UE5? I feel like this is exactly what AI slop is, you said it yourself it was 3 prompts thrown together. This has no useful functionality at all and is someone goofing around with an LLM for a little bit which is exactly what AI slop is rather than dedicating. This can't do 0.001% of what any of those tools I mentioned can for free.

replies.author: EverythingBOffensive
replies.body: is blender, unity, ue5 AI tools? I was talking about sites everyone here seems to generate sprites and stuff from. I was just saying why not tell an LLM to build your own tool that replaces it. The fuck would I say replace blender for lol. Its even free

replies.author: scratchieee
replies.body:
No, when you showed the AI slop tool that you made it seemed like you aren’t familiar with plugins for any major tool mentioned which all can do what you mentioned significantly better with almost no effort.

I’m curious why you would even post something like this, but your replies clearly show you have no idea what you are talking about. Most sprite generation tools have models trained on images with resources most individuals don’t have access to, which is why most image-generating tools are better than anything you can vibe and ask GPT to make.

Just another guy with a million dollar idea and absolutely no way to show any example because the idea falls flat on its face.

comments.author: Shriffles
comments.body: Come on dude. If you can't understand why your work is trash you have no stake in this.

replies.author: EverythingBOffensive
replies.body: I drew an entire game by hand and created, and wrote my own content for a game. According to the feedback of its first images it wasn't called trash by anyone.

replies.author: Shriffles
replies.body: I think I misunderstood your post my man. I assumed you just AI-prompted beginning to last. Sorry for that
